name: apiStabilityLeak
description: Reports exported APIs whose public surface exposes a less stable type

name: experimentalApiUsage
description: Warns when using an API marked @stability experimental

name: unstableApiUsage
description: Warns when using an API marked @stability unstable

name: floatingEffect
description: Detects Effect values that are neither yielded nor assigned

name: floatingEffectInVitest
description: Detects Effects returned from non-Effect-aware Vitest callbacks

name: missingEffectError
description: Detects Effect values with unhandled error types

name: missingEffectContext
description: Detects Effect values with unhandled context requirements

name: missingReturnYieldStar
description: Suggests using return yield* for Effects that never succeed

name: missingStarInYieldEffectGen
description: Detects bare yield (without *) inside Effect generator scopes

name: catchUnfailableEffect
description: Warns when using error handling on Effects that never fail

name: catchDieToOrDie
description: Suggests using Effect.orDie instead of Effect.catch or Effect.catchAll with an identity-forwarding Effect.die handler

name: timeoutCatchTagToTimeoutOrElse
description: Suggests dedicated timeout combinators instead of catching TimeoutError immediately after Effect.timeout

name: catchAllToMapError
description: Suggests using Effect.mapError instead of Effect.catch + Effect.fail

name: catchRefailToTapError
description: Suggests Effect.tapError for catch handlers that sequence an effect and then re-fail the original error

name: catchAllTagDispatchToCatchTag
description: Suggests Effect.catchTag or Effect.catchTags for catch-all handlers that re-fail unmatched tagged errors

name: catchIfTagToCatchTag
description: Suggests Effect.catchTag instead of Effect.catchIf with a _tag equality or Predicate.isTagged predicate

name: catchConditionalRefailToCatchIf
description: Suggests Effect.catchIf, Effect.catchCauseIf, or Effect.catchTag for conditional catch handlers that re-fail their untouched input

name: catchTagToCatchReason
description: Suggests Effect.catchReason or Effect.catchReasons for handlers that re-fail unmatched reason._tag branches

name: catchToOrElseSucceed
description: Suggests using Effect.orElseSucceed instead of Effect.catch + Effect.succeed

name: catchToIgnore
description: Suggests using Effect.ignore or Effect.ignoreCause instead of Effect.catch/catchCause returning Effect.void

name: catchChainToFirstSuccessOf
description: Suggests Effect.firstSuccessOf for consecutive error-independent Effect.catch fallbacks when the error type is preserved

name: multipleCatchTag
description: Suggests collapsing consecutive Effect.catchTag transformations into a single Effect.catchTags call when semantics stay equivalent

name: effectFnIife
description: Effect.fn or Effect.fnUntraced is called as an IIFE; use Effect.gen instead

name: tryCatchInEffectGen
description: Discourages try/catch in Effect generators in favor of Effect error handling

name: unnecessaryPipe
description: Removes pipe calls with no arguments

name: returnEffectInGen
description: Warns when returning an Effect in a generator causes nested Effect<Effect<...>>

name: unnecessaryPipeChain
description: Simplifies chained pipe calls into a single pipe call

name: effectSucceedWithVoid
description: Suggests using Effect.void instead of Effect.succeed(undefined) or Effect.succeed(void 0)

name: preferSucceedSomeOrNone
description: Suggests using Effect.succeedNone or Effect.succeedSome instead of wrapping Option.none or Option.some with Effect.succeed

name: unnecessaryEffectGen
description: Suggests removing Effect.gen when it contains only a single return statement

name: effectMapVoid
description: Suggests using Effect.asVoid instead of Effect.map(() => void 0), Effect.map(() => undefined), or Effect.map(() => {})

name: unnecessaryFailYieldableError
description: Suggests yielding yieldable errors directly instead of wrapping with Effect.fail

name: effectInVoidSuccess
description: Detects nested Effects in void success channels that may cause unexecuted effects

name: effectInFailure
description: Warns when an Effect is used inside an Effect failure channel

name: unknownInEffectCatch
description: Warns when catch callbacks return unknown instead of typed errors

name: globalErrorInEffectCatch
description: Warns when catch callbacks return global Error type instead of typed errors

name: globalErrorInEffectFailure
description: Warns when the global Error type is used in an Effect failure channel

name: abortControllerInEffect
description: Warns when manually constructing AbortController inside Effect generators instead of using Effect.abortSignal

name: cryptoRandomUUID
description: Warns when using crypto.randomUUID() outside Effect generators instead of the Effect Crypto module

name: cryptoRandomUUIDInEffect
description: Warns when using crypto.randomUUID() inside Effect generators instead of the Effect Crypto module

name: globalFetch
description: Warns when using the global fetch function outside Effect generators instead of the Effect HTTP client

name: globalFetchInEffect
description: Warns when using the global fetch function inside Effect generators instead of the Effect HTTP client

name: processEnv
description: Warns when reading process.env outside Effect generators instead of using Effect Config

name: processEnvInEffect
description: Warns when reading process.env inside Effect generators instead of using Effect Config

name: globalConsole
description: Warns when using console methods outside Effect generators instead of Effect.log/Logger

name: globalConsoleInEffect
description: Warns when using console methods inside Effect generators instead of Effect.log/Logger

name: globalDate
description: Warns when using Date.now() or new Date() outside Effect generators instead of Clock/DateTime

name: globalDateInEffect
description: Warns when using Date.now() or new Date() inside Effect generators instead of Clock/DateTime

name: globalRandom
description: Warns when using Math.random() outside Effect generators instead of the Random service

name: globalRandomInEffect
description: Warns when using Math.random() inside Effect generators instead of the Random service

name: preferEffectArray
description: Suggests Effect Array APIs for native array member references, with semantic caveats

name: preferEffectRecord
description: Suggests Effect Record APIs for native Object member references, with semantic caveats

name: preferEffectString
description: Suggests Effect String APIs for native String method invocations, with semantic caveats

name: preferNamespaceImport
description: Reports named imports from packages configured in namespaceImportPackages that should be namespace imports

name: preferBarrelImport
description: Reports imports of individual modules from packages configured in barrelImportPackages that should be named imports from the package barrel

name: globalTimers
description: Warns when using setTimeout/setInterval outside Effect generators instead of Effect.sleep/Schedule

name: globalTimersInEffect
description: Warns when using setTimeout/setInterval inside Effect generators instead of Effect.sleep/Schedule

name: runEffectInsideEffect
description: Suggests using Runtime or Effect.run*With methods instead of Effect.run* inside Effect contexts

name: preferSchemaOverJson
description: Suggests using Effect Schema for JSON operations instead of JSON.parse/JSON.stringify

name: effectGenUsesAdapter
description: Warns when using the deprecated adapter parameter in Effect.gen

name: effectFnImplicitAny
description: Mirrors noImplicitAny for unannotated Effect.fn, Effect.fnUntraced, and Effect.fnUntracedEager callback parameters when no outer contextual function type exists. Requires TS's noImplicitAny: true

name: strictBooleanExpressions
description: Enforces boolean types in conditional expressions for type safety

name: anyUnknownInErrorContext
description: Detects 'any' or 'unknown' types in Effect error or requirements channels

name: asyncFunction
description: Warns when declaring async functions and suggests using Effect values and Effect.gen for async control flow

name: scopeInLayerEffect
description: Suggests using Layer.scoped instead of Layer.effect when Scope is in requirements

name: strictEffectProvide
description: Warns when using Effect.provide with layers outside of application entry points

name: unsafeEffectTypeAssertion
description: Detects unsafe type assertions that narrow Effect, Stream, or Layer error or requirements channels

name: multipleEffectProvide
description: Warns against chaining Effect.provide calls which can cause service lifecycle issues

name: provideLayerSucceedToProvideService
description: Suggests providing inline Layer.succeed and Layer.effect services directly

name: missingLayerContext
description: Detects Layer values with unhandled context requirements

name: layerMergeAllWithDependencies
description: Detects interdependencies in Layer.mergeAll calls where one layer provides a service that another layer requires

name: schemaStructWithTag
description: Suggests using Schema.TaggedStruct instead of Schema.Struct with _tag field

name: schemaSync
description: Suggests Effect-based Schema decoding and encoding instead of synchronous methods

name: schemaSyncInEffect
description: Suggests using Effect-based Schema methods instead of sync methods inside Effect generators

name: schemaNumber
description: Suggests Schema.Finite and Schema.FiniteFromString instead of Schema.Number APIs when describing domain numbers

name: schemaLiteralNonFinite
description: Reports statically known non-finite numbers passed to Schema literal constructors

name: schemaUnionOfLiterals
description: Suggests combining multiple Schema.Literal calls in Schema.Union into a single Schema.Literal

name: newSchemaClass
description: Suggests using Schema make instead of new for Schema classes

name: missingEffectServiceDependency
description: Checks that Effect.Service dependencies satisfy all required layer inputs

name: leakingRequirements
description: Detects implementation services leaked in service methods

name: lazyEffect
description: Suggests avoiding exported zero-argument functions and service members that lazily return Effect or Stream values

name: lazyPromiseInEffectSync
description: Warns when Effect.sync lazily returns a Promise instead of using an async Effect constructor

name: promiseInEffectSuccess
description: Detects Promise types in Effect success channels where they are not awaited

name: nestedEffectGenYield
description: Warns when yielding a nested bare Effect.gen inside an existing Effect generator context

name: redundantMapError
description: Suggests hoisting a repeated trailing Effect.mapError from every yield in an Effect generator

name: redundantOrDie
description: Suggests hoisting a repeated trailing Effect.orDie from every yield in an Effect generator

name: unnecessaryArrowBlock
description: Suggests using a concise arrow body when the block only returns an expression

name: unnecessaryTypeofType
description: Suggests replacing typeof Schema.Type style annotations with the matching named type when available

name: preferSchemaTypeProperty
description: Disallows Schema.Schema.Type<typeof X> in favor of typeof X.Type

name: preferSchemaTaggedError
description: Suggests using Schema.TaggedError instead of Data.TaggedError

name: errorPayloadShadowsName
description: Detects error payload fields named `name` that shadow the error's own name

name: instanceOfSchema
description: Suggests using Schema.is instead of instanceof for Effect Schema types

name: genericEffectServices
description: Prevents services with type parameters that cannot be discriminated at runtime

name: overriddenSchemaConstructor
description: Prevents overriding constructors in Schema classes which breaks decoding behavior

name: schemaOpaqueInstanceMember
description: Disallows instance members in classes extending Schema.Opaque

name: schemaClassMissingBrand
description: Warns when Schema classes, errors, or Opaque classes omit the brand type argument

name: schemaClassObjectLiteral
description: Warns when object literals are checked as Schema class instances without the class prototype

name: redundantSchemaTagIdentifier
description: Suggests removing redundant identifier argument when it equals the tag value in Schema.TaggedClass/TaggedError/TaggedRequest

name: classSelfMismatch
description: Ensures Self type parameter matches the class name in Context/Service/Tag/Schema classes

name: effectFnOpportunity
description: Suggests using Effect.fn for functions that return an Effect

name: nonObjectEffectServiceType
description: Ensures Effect.Service types are objects, not primitives

name: deterministicKeys
description: Enforces deterministic naming for service/tag/error identifiers based on class names

name: missedPipeableOpportunity
description: Suggests using .pipe() for nested function calls

name: missingPipeableSignature
description: Reports exported fixed-arity functions whose call signatures have no corresponding pipeable overload

name: duplicatePackage
description: Warns when multiple versions of an Effect-related package are detected in the program

name: effectDoNotation
description: Suggests using Effect.gen or Effect.fn instead of the Effect.Do notation helpers

name: effectMapFlatten
description: Suggests using Effect.flatMap instead of Effect.map followed by Effect.flatten in piping flows

name: allOfMapToForEach
description: Suggests using Effect.forEach instead of Effect.all over an effectful Array#map

name: mapSomeToAsSome
description: Suggests using Effect.asSome instead of Effect.map when the mapper only wraps the success value with Option.some

name: flatMapToMap
description: Suggests using Effect.map instead of Effect.flatMap when the callback only wraps its result with Effect.succeed

name: flatMapToTap
description: Suggests Effect.tap when a flatMap or andThen callback runs an effect and returns its unchanged parameter

name: flatMapIgnoredParamToAndThen
description: Suggests using Effect.andThen instead of Effect.flatMap when a zero-parameter callback returns an existing Effect value

name: matchEffectToMatch
description: Suggests Effect.match or Effect.matchCause when both Effect.matchEffect handlers only return Effect.succeed

name: matchEffectToMapBoth
description: Suggests Effect.mapBoth when Effect.matchEffect only transforms the failure and success channels

name: flatMapConditionalToFilterOrFail
description: Suggests Effect.filterOrFail or Effect.filterOrElse when Effect.flatMap conditionally passes its input through with Effect.succeed

name: optionMatchToFromOption
description: Suggests Effect.fromOption when Option.match or an Option tag conditional only converts Some to Effect.succeed and None to Effect.fail

name: syncToSucceed
description: Suggests using Effect.succeed instead of Effect.sync when the thunk returns a constant value

name: effectSleepZeroToYieldNow
description: Suggests Effect.yieldNow for cooperative yielding instead of sleeping for zero duration

name: extendsNativeError
description: Warns when a class directly extends the native Error class

name: nodeBuiltinImport
description: Warns when importing Node.js built-in modules that have Effect-native counterparts

name: obsoleteMatchImport
description: Warns when importing @effect/match in projects targeting Effect v4, where Match is included directly in the effect package

name: obsoleteSchemaImport
description: Warns when importing @effect/schema in projects targeting Effect v4, where Schema is included directly in the effect package

name: newPromise
description: Warns when constructing promises with new Promise instead of using Effect APIs

name: outdatedApi
description: Detects usage of APIs that have been removed or renamed in Effect v4

name: serviceNotAsClass
description: Warns when Context.Service is used as a variable instead of a class declaration

name: preferUnsafeConstructor
description: Suggests replacing Effect.runSync of a pure effect constructor with the synchronous *Unsafe variant exported by the same module

name: preferTypedSchemaDecoder
description: Suggests typed Schema decoders when the input is assignable to the schema's Encoded type

name: acquireReleaseDisposable
description: Suggests Effect.acquireDisposable when Effect.acquireRelease only invokes the acquired resource's disposal protocol

name: raceFirstWithSleepToTimeout
description: Suggests Effect.timeoutOrElse when Effect.raceFirst has exactly one sleep- or delay-based timer arm

name: runOfExitToRunExit
description: Suggests using Effect.runPromiseExit instead of passing Effect.exit to Effect.runPromise
